name: H5N1 bird flu
summary: Sporadic H5N1 human cases from animals; no human-to-human spread
state: Washington State reported a human H5N1 case on 15 Oct in a Yakima County resident exposed to infected dairy cattle; the person was not hospitalised, and the state found no human-to-human transmission (26 Oct alert). No new cluster had been reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Risk to the public is low. Avoid contact with sick or dead birds and report them to Defra.

sources.title: Washington State DOH — Health alert: human avian influenza case

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.

rubric.watch: Human clusters under investigation, rising human cases, or new mammalian species spread.
